metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to inquire about pricing for a new solar panel installation. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Charles Thompson. I’m looking to inquire about pricing for your post-surgical wound care services. Of course, Charles! Can you tell me a bit more about your needs? Well, I had a complex abdominal surgery and need regular wound care assistance. I understand. We have skilled nursing care that can assist with wound management. What are the prices for that service? Our skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 for 1 to 2 hours per visit. Okay, I see. Do you have male nurses available? Yes, we can accommodate that request. I’ll make note of your preference for male nurses. Great, thank you. Also, I need detailed progress reports for my VA. Absolutely, we can provide detailed progress reports for the VA. How often do you recommend the visits? Typically, we recommend at least 2 visits per week for effective wound management. That sounds good. Can I schedule a visit for this week? Yes, let me check our availability. When would be convenient for you? I’m free on Wednesday afternoon. Let me see... Yes, we have an opening at 2 PM on Wednesday. Perfect, please schedule that. I’ll go ahead and schedule that for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Actually, could you send me some information about your other services? Certainly! I’ll email you a list of our services and pricing after this call. Thank you. I’d appreciate that. You’re welcome! I’ll also send you our care plan details for future reference. That sounds great, thank you. No problem at all. Just to recap, we have you scheduled for Wednesday at 2 PM. Yes, thank you. You're welcome! If you have any other questions or need assistance, feel free to call back anytime. I will, thanks again! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, have a great day! You too, goodbye!
